definition: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol that defines how artificial intelligence agents communicate with each other across different systems.
details: It is intended to allow agents built by different vendors or frameworks to discover one another, exchange messages, and coordinate tasks.
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is the difference between a search engine and a helper who actually finishes the task. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Agent2Agent.
